ask.title: Ask anything across your notes
ask.description: Utter searches your meeting transcripts, summaries, and voice notes to answer with direct citations.
ask.placeholder: Ask a question about your notes…

suggestions.actionItems: What are my open action items?
suggestions.decisions: What key decisions were made recently?
suggestions.thisWeek: Summarize everything I worked on this week
suggestions.followUps: Who do I need to follow up with?

actions.empty: No open action items across your notes.
actions.emptyHint: Action items extracted from your voice notes and meetings will appear here automatically.
actions.allDone: All caught up! Every action item is complete.
actions.showDoneHint: Turn on 'Show completed' above to see finished items.

notes.importMediaSuccess: Meeting transcribed & summarized with action items
notes.liveStreamingHint: Transcribing as you speak. A title, summary and action items are added when you stop.
notes.startSpeakingHint: Start speaking. The transcript appears here as you talk.
notes.discardConfirm: Nothing will be added to Notes. The {{duration}} of audio stays on Home, where you can still transcribe it. To save it as a note, press Stop instead.

speakers.label: Speakers:
speakers.renameHint: Click a speaker to rename them.
speakers.single: Only one speaker was found, so the note was left as it was.

garbled.message_one: {{count}} recorded note looks transcribed in the wrong language.
garbled.message_other: {{count}} recorded notes look transcribed in the wrong language.

home.title: Dictate in any app
home.body: Click into any text field, press <kbd>{{shortcut}}</kbd> and speak. Your words are typed where the cursor is.
home.bodyNoShortcut: Set a dictation shortcut below to get started.
home.cancelledHint: You cancelled this recording, so it wasn’t typed anywhere. The audio is kept here in case you need it.

recordingKept.title: Recording cancelled
recordingKept.description: Nothing was typed. The audio is saved on Home if you want to transcribe it.

floatingBarHidden.title: Floating bar hidden for 1 hour
floatingBarHidden.description: Your shortcut still works. Turn the bar off for good in Settings.

noSpeech.description: Listening to: {{mic}}. Bluetooth headsets often sound too quiet for dictation; try your computer’s built-in mic.

intro.dictionary: Names, terms and spellings Utter should get right. Add “misspelling -> correct” to fix a word the model keeps getting wrong.
intro.snippets: Say a short phrase and Utter types the full text: an address, a sign-off, a meeting link.
intro.styles: Write differently in each app: casual in chat, formal in email, precise in your code editor.

engine.providerHint: Your words are sent to this provider to be cleaned up.
engine.appleHint: On your Mac. Nothing leaves your computer. Add an AI provider for stronger rewriting.
engine.builtinHint: Basic fixes only, on your computer. Set up an AI provider, or use Apple Intelligence, for real cleanup, styles and Command mode.
engine.localHint: On your Mac, offline. Nothing leaves your computer.
engine.ollamaStopped: Ollama is installed but not running. Open it and Utter will use it for summaries, Ask and rewrites — privately, on your Mac.

cleanup.label: Clean up with AI
cleanup.description: Fixes punctuation, capitalization and grammar, and applies your style for the app you’re in.

fillers.label: Remove filler words
fillers.description: Drops “um”, “uh” and similar so your text reads cleanly.

context.label: Use what’s on screen
context.description: Reads the app and text around your cursor to match names, casing and spacing.

voiceCommands.label: Voice commands
voiceCommands.description: Understands spoken formatting and corrections, like “new line” or “scratch that”.

whisper.label: Whisper mode
whisper.description: Boosts quiet speech so you can dictate softly in shared spaces.

say.title: What you can say
say.description: Works while Voice commands is on.

scratchThat.result: Deletes the last sentence you said

pressEnter.result: Types your text, then sends it

search.result: Opens a search instead of typing

snippets.duplicate: You already have a snippet for “{{trigger}}”.

styles.empty: No app styles yet. Everywhere else uses your default cleanup.
styles.needsCleanup: Styles only apply while “Clean up with AI” is on (Smart tab).
